2: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
3: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
4: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
5: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
6: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
7: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
8: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
9: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
10: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
11: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
12: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
13: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
